notes.title: Reboot My Heart released !
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39755770/80e62e09dbec26419e050e0e5507891270cb246e.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce the release of our new game, a visual novel, called Reboot My Heart:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530660/Reboot_My_Heart/
[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[b]Engaging Narrative:[/b] A humorous and thought-provoking visual novel with 3 different ends influenced by your choices.

[b]Dynamic Characters:[/b] Explore Mathew’s struggles, Masha’s perspective, and his android counterpart.

[b]Unexpected Twists: [/b]A unique take on love, identity, and self-discovery.

[b]Short and Sweet Gameplay:[/b]A 30-60 minute story-driven experience.

[i]When science meets romance, expect the unexpected. Are you ready to reboot your heart?[/i]

notes.title: New update + Fix + Poll
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913392/13d2baf273644f4dbe3bd307c50a930f4dbcb2ab.png[/img]
Hello everyone!

Today is a big update, I tried to answer all feedback and fix almost all issues you encountered.
You are more than 25.000 players on MMT, thank you!
I also added 2 new icons on the main menu to access all the future Meet My game series but also to vote for it! Yes, a public poll just started allowing you to vote for the next game!

[h1]VOTE NOW: [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/vote-for-next-my-103928774?]https://www.patreon.com/posts/vote-for-next-my-103928774?[/url][/h1]


[h2]Patchnote:[/h2]

- Thank to many players reporting on Discord or in the Steam Discussions our mistakes we managed to fix many flaws on pictures. Special thanks to [b]사라로 , Circle Nine, Ashyne, Klamos, T-Rex91[/b] for their help on this!
I will not make a list of all pictures modified, there are a lot!

- Fix sound bug, now "mute" on music or SFX is now correctly saved.

[b]- You can now take screenshot in the winning screen!!![/b]
- You can now swap between the full picture and the 3 zooms (bottom, middle, top) after the animation.
[b]- You can now skip the animation and/or go to the next level by pressing SPACE BAR.[/b]

- We added a "Picture saved in MyPicture folder" notification when you take a screenshot on the winning screen or in the gallery. The message disapear when you rollover the screenshot button again. We hope it will help people to find their naughty captures!

- Added two buttons on the main menu to access the poll and the other games of the Meet My series.

- Improved ZH translation thanks to ZZ!
- Improved PL translation thanks to Klamos!

- Fixed a bug with the 5 error achievements.
- Fixed a bug with the "next screen animation" going under the UI instead of above the UI.
- Reworked icon of the game.

Also all those changes will be available in the next SEXTS update we are gonna push very soon! If you didn't player it, it's free to play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2279510/SEXTS/

notes.title: Community Challenge! 10.000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
[b]Hello SEXTS fans! [/b]

[h2]I'm proud to announce that a new typing game on the exact same model as SEXTS is about to arrive on Steam on March 23rd:[/h2]
[h1]MEET MY TEACHER![/h1]

This new game will have new features and improved UI/visuals, new music and (I listened your feedback) more pictures with sex! And one more time for [u][b]FREE[/b][/u]!

Many of you also [b]asked for a one hand mode[/b] and in the new features, the major one is [b]TWO NEW GAME MODES[/b]: CVBN and Arrows, allowing you to play while doing something else!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779460/Meet_My_Teacher/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2779460/ss_32828e597cf74a3fa345158bc343668ae7ee332b.jpg[/img][/url]

Some of you may not like the fact that the game is typing again and may find it "too close" to SEXTS but this method of work will allow me to push in SEXTS all the new features made for Meet My Teacher so you can expect a big 1.2 update on March 23rd!

[h1]For this upcoming event, I need your help![/h1]
[h1]Objective: 10.000 wishlist[/h1]
Wishlist the game today so we can reach the objective of [b]10.000 wishlists before March 23rd![/b]
If we reach the objective, I will organize a big giveaway the week of the release to win to win DLCs of this new episode!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478791/339f054b489bfb9acc51f8359d2a1de6ebe91344.png[/img]
[h2]Check the trailer & wishlist:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779460/Meet_My_Teacher/

All our news on [url=https://twitter.com/Nsfw18G]X.com[/url] and [url=discord.gg/SUp8drcewR]Discord[/url].
